name: Craven County, NC
findings: Craven County has 307 nonprofit organizations. 128 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 103 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Craven County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 17 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Craven County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 94 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
